title: Compatibility and reversible shooting for connections between relative equilibria
exact_target: Prove homoclinic and heteroclinic connections involving unstable relative equilibria in celestial mechanics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002555 (AIM-PHYSICS-0063). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 26.

status_qualification: The source does not quantify over every unstable relative equilibrium, fix masses or prescribe a particular pair. Existence in a specified compatible setting is required, and a universal connection claim would be stronger than the source. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
